verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents management APIs that cover connections, transformations and libraries, audit logs, usage metrics and event audit metadata, so a meaningful share of workspace operations can be done programmatically. However, no evidence claims full API parity with the UI, and many UI-managed features have no documented API in the pack. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API coverage for audiences, tracking plans, alerts, consent, profiles and Reverse ETL setup, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found none), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
